name: Flix (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with a dark green fruited eradicated ash tree.
history: The official flag of Flix is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with the dark green fruited ash of the arms, 5/6 of the height and 4/9 of the length of the cloth, at the centre; approved initially by the municipal council on 29 January 2010, definitively on 2 September 2010 and published in the DOGC.
